'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Tom Hollingworth DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tom Hollingworth]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Invasion / In Complete Control|Theed-D-invasion.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Tom Hollingsworth
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
